instruction: Read docs/TASK_PHASE14.md FIRST (sections 1-4 and 7), then in contour.yaml: group store (Store Codes And Contracts: the phase-14 sentences of the description, the paragraph 'Implementation (phase 14)', examples 10, 12, 13-15; Manage Watchlist: the paragraph 'Seeding through the implementation', example 5; dataObject Code Database), group cluster (Build Clusters: the impl level, examples 4-5; Find Similar: the paragraph 'Through the implementation', example 3; Match Watchlist: example 4; Recheck Watchlist: the paragraph 'Through the implementation', examples 9-11; dataObjects Cluster and Alert), group ingest (Ingest Block: the description, the paragraph 'Standard proxies (phase 14)', examples 14-20; Follow Chain: the description, the paragraph 'Phase 14', examples 11-13), group cli (Command Line: the subcommand list, the paragraph 'Standard proxies (phase 14)', examples 44-50) and group rpc (RPC Client example 10: PRICES). You own ethsc/ingest.py, ethsc/store.py, ethsc/cluster.py, ethsc/cli.py, ethsc/config.py, tests/helpers.py and the NEW tests/test_proxy_p14.py; change nothing else -- ethsc/evm.py, ethsc/fingerprint.py, ethsc/rpc.py, ethsc/report.py and ethsc/charts.py are frozen and the acceptance checks their diff. config.py: PRICES gains "eth_getStorageAt": 80. store.py: addresses gains implementation TEXT as its last column; on open an addresses table without it gets ALTER TABLE addresses ADD COLUMN implementation TEXT the way origin is migrated, no UPDATE of old rows; set_implementation(address, implementation) is one UPDATE of the stored row (both lowercased; unknown address: nothing, no raise); implementation(address) -> str or None; implementations() -> dict over the addresses whose code has std_proxy = 1, each mapped to {"implementation": str or None, "code_id": the code_id stored at the implementation address or None}, one SELECT; add_seed uses the implementation's code_id when implementations() gives one for the address, else the address's own. ingest.py: constants IMPL_SLOT and BEACON_SLOT, the pure slot_address(word), and fetch_implementation(store, address, block, get_storage, get_code) exactly as the Contour paragraph says (IMPL_SLOT first, BEACON_SLOT when it reads zero, the implementation's code fetched and stored like a candidate with origin "impl" only when it came from IMPL_SLOT and is not stored, a beacon never fetched, any exception or rejected word ends the attempt, the stored value never cleared); ingest_block(..., get_storage=None, on_upgrades=None): after the candidate loop, step 2 reads the slots of the standard proxies stored in this call and of the known candidates present in store.implementations() (read once, before the loop), in candidate order, and records {"address", "old", "new", "block"} in stats["upgrades"] when a known proxy's stored implementation was not None and differs from the new one (a NULL that resolves is silent); step 3 produces the alerts: a proxy stored in this call whose implementation's code is stored is matched with the implementation's bytes (address = the proxy, origin = the proxy's origin), an implementation stored in this call with its own bytes (origin "impl"); stats has exactly ten keys, the old nine unchanged in value; on_upgrades is called once per call like on_alerts, after it, on both exits. follow_chain(..., on_upgrades=None) hands down get_storage over rpc.call("eth_getStorageAt", [address, slot, tag]) with the eth_getCode tag rule, checking spent + price(eth_getStorageAt) + price(eth_getCode) <= daily_budget before each read (None without a call when it fails), charging price(eth_getStorageAt) per successful read, and summary gains "upgrades". Under workers > 1 you may run the slot reads in the pool; store writes stay in the calling thread. cluster.py: _LEVEL_RANK gains "impl": 4; build_clusters adds the impl clusters from store.implementations() (key = implementation address, members = the proxies, >= 2); find_similar and recheck_watchlist score a standard proxy whose implementations() entry has a code_id by that code_id's stored fingerprint instead of its own, on both sides; match_watchlist is unchanged; keep reading the store through public methods only, no code_by_id and no similarity in the three searches. cli.py: an on_upgrades sink printing "UPGRADE\t<proxy>\t<old>\t<new>\t<block>" after the block's ALERT lines, untouched by --alert-on; recheck --origin gains the choice impl; seed add --fetch follows the Contour paragraph and examples 44, 46 and 49 to the letter -- the number and order of rpc calls is pinned, including the held-proxy-with-NULL-implementation case; cluster <addr> may print two lines. tests/helpers.py: FakeRpc gains storage=None: eth_getStorageAt answers storage[params[0]][params[1]] when storage is a dict, the zero word "0x" + 64 zeros when the address or slot is absent, and raises KeyError(method) as before when storage is None; the call is recorded either way. Add nothing else there and remove nothing. Keep the module docstrings true: one short sentence each on the implementation. Five old tests were already updated to the new column list and the new PRICES; do not edit them. tests/test_proxy_p14.py is smoke only: at most 5 tests (slot_address on two words, a set_implementation/implementations round trip, one ingest_block with a get_storage, one seed add --fetch printing the impl line), comparing scalars and short strings; import FakeRpc, load_hex, temp_store, block_codes, block_receipts from tests/helpers.py, do not write your own stubs; every db in a tempfile.mkdtemp() directory. The acceptance runs a probe of all 28 new examples first: read its output line by line; each line names the example and the value it wants.

Read docs/TASK_PHASE14.md FIRST (sections 2 and 3.2), then contour.yaml: group store, Store Codes And Contracts examples 13-15 and Manage Watchlist example 5; group cluster, Build Clusters examples 4-5, Find Similar example 3, Match Watchlist example 4, Recheck Watchlist examples 9-11; group ingest, Ingest Block examples 14-20 and Follow Chain examples 11-13; group cli, Command Line examples 44-50. ethsc/ingest.py, ethsc/store.py, ethsc/cluster.py, ethsc/cli.py and tests/helpers.py are in your context: read them, do not modify them. You write ONE NEW file, tests/test_proxy_examples_p14.py: one unittest test per example (28 tests, at most 45), named after the example (test_store_example_13_..., test_manage_watchlist_example_5_..., test_build_clusters_example_4_..., test_find_similar_example_3_..., test_match_watchlist_example_4_..., test_recheck_watchlist_example_9_..., test_ingest_block_example_14_..., test_follow_chain_example_11_..., test_command_line_example_44_...), each asserting every value the example's 'then' states, exactly (full addresses, full dicts, full ALERT and UPGRADE lines with their tabs, exit codes, call lists in order, row counts, credits). Fixtures: tests/fixtures/storage_26077729.json ({address: {slot: word}}) and code_impl_72b97171.hex via load_hex. Import FakeRpc (with its storage= argument), load_hex, block_codes, block_receipts, temp_store, block_store from tests/helpers.py; no stub classes named Fake*; a get_storage or get_code callable for ingest_block may be a small function or a plain class of your own. Build the phase-13 database of Store example 15 with sqlite3 and plain INSERTs as the example says. Set INFURA_API_KEY to a dummy with mock.patch.dict where a cli example runs. Every db in a tempfile.mkdtemp() directory. Do not edit any other file: the acceptance refuses a diff on tracked files.
